latest.title: Connection Stability & Inline Editing Fixes
latest.summary: Fixed connection crash when default schema is empty, eliminated duplicate query loader, and improved in-cell updates with NULL & type coercion.

highlights.title: Empty Database Connection Fix
highlights.description: Fixed crash on connect when no default database is selected and added auto-selection for available databases.

highlights.title: Cleaner Single Query Loader
highlights.description: Removed duplicate inner spinner overlay so long-running queries show one clean execution status.

highlights.title: Enhanced In-Cell Table Updates
highlights.description: Fixed in-cell update queries to support NULL values, IS NULL key predicates, and strict column type coercion.

highlights.title: Refined Update Notification Modal
highlights.description: Fixed cross button and version badge positioning for clean, unclipped dialog header layout.
